capabilities: Design covers with themes and images
Validate files and quote print prices
extras: Freemium: local preview and PDF export are free; physical printing and shipping are paid. Desktop only (mobile unsupported) and requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; tested only on macOS, with Windows and Linux needing further testing. Early release (version 0.0.2 review candidate).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into print-ready books or order physical printed copies.
summary: Plugin that turns Markdown notes into 6x9 inch books with a local PDF preview, printable covers, and optional paid printing and shipping.
